name: realistic-vinyl-player-tests
description: Playwright checks for ../index.html. The app itself needs nothing installed.

scripts.test: for b in chromium firefox webkit; do node verify.js $b && node extra.js $b || exit 1; done
scripts.test:quick: node verify.js chromium && node extra.js chromium
scripts.test:audio: for b in chromium firefox webkit; do node audio.js $b; node elpath.js $b; node alias.js $b; done; node wear.js; node reduced.js
scripts.parity: [ -n "$ORIGINAL" ] || { echo 'Set ORIGINAL=/path/to/Vinyl-Player/index.html to compare the layout with the original.'; exit 0; }; node shots.js "$ORIGINAL" out/ref && node shots.js ../index.html out/new && node cmp.js out/ref out/new 3
